answers.why: Ezekiel is sent to speak to the house of Israel, the national community.
The house of Israel receives a watchman who must warn them.
The elders of Judah are leaders of the community sitting before Ezekiel.
The God of Israel is the nation's God whose glory appears in Jerusalem.
The house of Israel collectively commits abominations at the sanctuary.
The God of Israel is the nation's God whose glory moves within the temple.
The residue of Israel consists of surviving people threatened by judgment on Jerusalem.
Judah shares Israel's collective iniquity in a land filled with bloodshed.
The God of Israel names the nation's God whose glory stands above the cherubim.
The God of Israel names the nation's God seen in Ezekiel's vision by the Chebar.
God addresses the house of Israel with plural pronouns concerning their thoughts and deeds.
